scope: City of Atwater government and Merced County government; other cities, school districts and independent special districts deferred
publication_rules: Publish only official public records or reviewed public-release copies.
Preserve redactions and exclude unnecessary personal contact information from indexes.
Keep originals, amendments, provenance and page citations distinct.
No collected record does not mean no filing.
A disclosed interest is not a finding of wrongdoing.
Do not represent templates or guidance as completed filings.
